1. litter quality
a. import and tidy data
(Table S2)
```{r}
cn_initial <- read.csv("cn_data_final.csv", header=T, na.strings=c("","NA"))

cn_initial<- cn_initial %>% 
  mutate(cnratio= carbon/nitrogen,
         )
#adding sample size
sample_size <- cn_initial %>%
  group_by(litter_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n())

View(cn_initial)
#Mean dataframe for C, N and C:N
nitrogenmean<-cn_initial %>% 
  group_by(litter_type, treatment) %>%  
  summarise(nmean=mean(nitrogen),
            nse=sd(nitrogen)/sqrt(n()),
            CNmean=mean(cnratio),
            CNse=sd(cnratio)/sqrt(n()),
            Cmean=mean(carbon),
            Cse=sd(carbon/sqrt(n()))) %>% 
  mutate(treatment = fct_recode(treatment,
    "Invaded" = "Acacia",
    "Uninvaded" = "Grassland")) %>% 
  ungroup()
 

litterqualitymean<-nitrogenmean %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(nmean, nse, CNmean, CNse, Cmean, Cse),
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(n|CN|C)(mean|se)"
  )

litterqualitymean$variable <- recode(litterqualitymean$variable,
                               "n" = "Nitrogen (%)",
                               "CN" = "C:N ratio",
                               "C" = "Carbon (%)")
```

b. plotting mean and sem for N and C:N
(figure S1)
```{r}

ggplot(
  litterqualitymean %>%
    filter(variable != "Carbon (%)"),
  aes(x = litter_type, y = mean)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, shape = 16) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ factor(variable, c("Nitrogen (%)", "C:N ratio")),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10)) +
  labs(
    x = "Litter type",
    y = "Mean ± SE"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),

    legend.position = "none",

    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),

    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
  )


ggsave("figureS1.tiff",
       width = 7, height = 5,
       units = "in", dpi = 300,
       compression = "lzw")

```

c. Model for litter nitrogen
```{r}
stat_nitrogen<-lm(nitrogen ~ litter_type, data=cn_initial)
display(stat_nitrogen)
summary(stat_nitrogen)
anova(stat_nitrogen)
emmeans(stat_nitrogen, list(pairwise~litter_type), adjust="tukey")
```

2. Decomposition dynamics
a. import and tidy for mass loss
```{r}
litter<- read.csv("decomposition_final.csv")

mass_loss_means<- litter %>% group_by(litter_type, treatment, round) %>% 
  summarise(mass_at_t=mean(mass_remaining),
            t=mean(days),
            round=mean(round),
            mass_at_t_se = round(sd(mass_remaining)/sqrt(n()))
            )

round<-c(1,2,3,4,5)
days<-c(30, 71, 171, 300, 580 )
mass_loss_means$round<-replace(mass_loss_means$round, mass_loss_means$round %in% round, days)
```

b. plotting mass loss over time
(Figure S3)
```{r}
ggplot(
  data = mass_loss_means,
  aes(x = round, y = mass_at_t, shape = litter_type)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = litter_type),
    size = 2.4,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~treatment)+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = unique(mass_loss_means$round)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Days since deployment",
    y = "Fraction of mass remaining",
    shape = "Litter type"
  ) +
  scale_color_grey(start = 0.2, end = 0.7)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(3, 1, 4, 6))+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),

    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key = element_blank(),

    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),

    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 13),

  )

ggsave("figureS3.tiff",
       width = 9, height = 4,
       units = "in", dpi = 300,

```

3. decomposition rates (k)
a. k estimation by nls and tidy
```{r}
models1 <- litter %>%
  group_by(litter_type, treatment, point_code, plot_code, experiment, origin, counter_point_code) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ tryCatch(
     nls(mass_remaining ~  exp(-k * time), data = ., start = list(k = 0.5)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )),
    tidied = map(model, ~ if (!is.null(.)) tidy(.) else NULL)
  ) %>%
  unnest(tidied)
```

Means of decomposition rates by environment and litter type (Table 1)
```{r}
model_result <- models1 %>%
  group_by(treatment, litter_type, experiment) %>%
  summarise(
    average_k = round(mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    se_k = round(sd(estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

b. Mixed effects model for in-situ k differences (Table S8)
```{r}
stat_home_2<-lmer(estimate~litter_type+ (1|plot_code), data=models1 %>% filter(
  (litter_type == "Grassland litter" & treatment == "Uninvaded") |
    (litter_type %in% c("Acacia litter", "Acacia understory litter") & treatment == "Invaded") 
  ))
display(stat_home_2)
anova(stat_home_2)
emm_=emmeans(stat_home_2, ~litter_type)
pairs(emm_, simple='each')
tab_model(stat_home_2)
```


Number of litter bags and sets analysed (Table S3)
```{r}
with(litter ,table(litter_type,round, treatment))
with(models1, table(litter_type, treatment))
with(models1, count(litter_type, treatment))
```

d. Mixed effects model for combined effect of environment and litter type (Table S4, S5, S6)
```{r}
stat_reciprocal <- lmer(
  estimate ~ treatment * litter_type + (1 | plot_code),
  data = models1 %>% filter(litter_type %in% c("Acacia litter", "Acacia understory litter", "Grassland litter"))
)
display(stat_reciprocal)
anova(stat_reciprocal)

emm=emmeans(stat_reciprocal, ~treatment*litter_type)
emm=emmeans(stat_reciprocal, c("treatment", "litter_type"))

pairs(emm, simple='each')
```

letters for pairwise difference
```{r}


emm_pairs<-pairs(emm, adjust="tukey")
pw_df <- as.data.frame(emm_pairs)
# Generate compact letters
pvals <- pw_df$p.value
names(pvals) <- gsub(" - ", "-", pw_df$contrast)
letters <- multcompView::multcompLetters(
  pvals,
  threshold = 0.05,
  Letters = LETTERS
)

letters$Letters
```


```{r}
#table for effect sizes
tab_model(stat_reciprocal, pred.labels = TRUE)

anova(stat_reciprocal)%>% as.data.frame() %>% write.csv(file = "reciprocal anova.csv")
```

e. home and reciprocal decomposition bar graph (Figure 3)
```{r}
ggplot(
  data = model_result %>%
    filter(litter_type %in% c(
      "Acacia litter",
      "Grassland litter",
      "Acacia understory litter"
    )),
  aes(
    x = litter_type,
    y = average_k,
    fill = treatment,
    pattern = experiment
  )
) +
  geom_col_pattern(
    just = 0.5,
    width = 0.5,
    colour = "black",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    pattern_angle = 45,
    pattern_colour = NA,
pattern_fill = "white",
pattern_density = 0.40,
pattern_spacing = 0.03
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = average_k - se_k, ymax = average_k + se_k),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    width = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Invaded" = "#77ACED",
  "Uninvaded" = "#6DBF6D"))+
  scale_pattern_manual(values = c(
    "Home" = "circle",
    "Reciprocal deployment" = "none"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Litter type",
    y = expression("Decay rate (k, " ~ y^-1 ~ ") ± SE"),
    fill = "Environment",
    pattern = "Experiment"
  )+
  guides(
  fill = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(pattern = "none")
  ),
  pattern = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(fill = "grey50")
  )
)

ggsave("figure3.tiff",
       width = 8, height = 4,
       units = "in", dpi = 300,
       compression = "lzw")

```

f. Dataset for N vs K regression
```{r}
cn_means<- cn_initial %>% 
  group_by(origin, litter_type) %>% 
  summarise(avgnitrogen=mean(nitrogen), avgcarbon=mean(carbon), avgCN=mean(CN)) %>% 
  ungroup()

NandKdataframe<- models1 %>% left_join(cn_means)

NandKdataframe_m<-NandKdataframe %>% group_by(plot_code, treatment, litter_type) %>% summarise(k=mean(estimate), n =mean(avgnitrogen))
```

g. Linear models for NvsK (Table S7) 
```{r}
NandKdataframeregression <- NandKdataframe   %>% lmer(formula = estimate~avgnitrogen*treatment+(1|plot_code)+(avgnitrogen|litter_type))

summary(NandKdataframeregression)
anova(NandKdataframeregression)
tab_model((NandKdataframeregression))
r.squaredGLMM(NandKdataframeregression)


#slopes for each environment
reg_slopes <- emtrends(
  NandKdataframeregression,
  ~ treatment,
  var = "avgnitrogen"
)

reg_slopes
```

g. Figure for N vs K model (Figure 4)
```{r}
pred_reg <- ggpredict(
  NandKdataframeregression,
  terms = c("avgnitrogen [all]", "treatment")
)
pred_reg$treatment <- pred_reg$group


ggplot(
  data = NandKdataframe_m,
  aes(x = n, y = k )
) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 1.2, aes(shape = litter_type)) +

  # predicted line
  geom_line(
    data = pred_reg ,
    aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, linetype = group),
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
  values = c(
    "Invaded" = "dashed",
    "Uninvaded" = "solid"
  )
)+
  # confidence interval
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_reg,
    aes(x = x, y=predicted, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = NA
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Initial Nitrogen content of leaf litter (%)",
    y = expression("Decay rate (k, " ~ y^-1 ~ ")"),
    shape = "Litter type",
  ) +
  guides(
  shape = "none",
  color = "none",
  fill = "none")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Invaded" = "#6B9AD3",
    "Uninvaded" = "#5A9E5A"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Invaded" = "#D6E3F3",
    "Uninvaded" = "#D8ECD8"
  )) +
  facet_wrap(~treatment)+
   theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
theme(
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
   legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  legend.text = element_text(),
  

  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),

  axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.6),
  axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),

  panel.grid = element_blank(),

  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
  plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
)

  ggsave("figure4.tiff",
       width = 5, height = 3,
       units = "in", dpi = 300,
       compression = "lzw")
```
